fields.Name: IT79 - Auth Provider Token Validation
fields.Description: The server auth stack's token/identity-validation seams that are deterministic without a live IdP (packages/AuthProviders + the AuthProviderFactory MJServer's JWT path resolves through). AV1: all 8 shipped provider types are ClassFactory-registered and resolvable case-insensitively. AV2: createProvider dispatches each type to its concrete class and refuses a jwksUri-less config. AV3: register() admits a valid provider and refuses one whose validateConfig fails. AV4: issuer resolution normalizes trailing slash and case, rejects unknown issuers before any network call, and aggregates same-issuer/different-audience providers (the multi-app contract). AV5: a self-minted RS256 host assertion (node:crypto keypair, no IdP) verifies through HostIdentityProvider.VerifyHostAssertion with all identity claims mapped. AV6: the rejection matrix enforces signature provenance, payload integrity, audience binding, expiry, the 10-minute max-age ceiling, the explicit-exp guard, and the email floor — with no identity leak on rejection. AV7: claim-mapping parity for MagicLinkProvider (OIDC + name-splitting fallback) and HostIdentityProvider (alternate claim names). UN-GATED 2026-08-11: the config fixtures are corrected. makeConfig supplied only the base validateConfig fields (name/issuer/audience/jwksUri), but auth0 and okta additionally require domain, msal tenantId, cognito region + userPoolId, and all six OAuth providers clientId — so a config the check called 'complete' was not. It now supplies the union of every shipped provider's own requirements; each provider reads only its own fields. AV1-AV7 pass.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Provider-type dispatch, registration governance, pre-network issuer rejection, and real RS256 assertion verification (happy path + full rejection matrix) all hold with zero IdP or network dependency.
